title: DAY6: From Congratulations to Fourever
description: From The Day and Congratulations to Every DAY6, Even of Day and Fourever: ten questions on DAY6's music, members and instruments.

questions.question: DAY6 made their debut on September 7, 2015 with which EP?
questions.fun_fact: Its lead single was Congratulations, and a week after release the EP reached No. 2 on Billboard's World Albums chart.

questions.question: Which song kicked off the Every DAY6 monthly project in January 2017?
questions.fun_fact: Billboard later placed it at No. 81 on its staff list of the 100 greatest K-pop songs of the 2010s.

questions.question: Which DAY6 studio album of June 2017 collected the first half of the Every DAY6 releases?
questions.fun_fact: Billboard ranked it No. 14 on its staff list of the 25 greatest K-pop albums of the 2010s.

questions.question: Young K is best known as the DAY6 player of which instrument?
questions.fun_fact: Hosting KBS Cool FM's Kiss the Radio won him one of the two DJ Awards at the 2023 KBS Entertainment Awards.

questions.question: Who sits behind the drum kit in DAY6?
questions.fun_fact: He trained for only about three months at JYP Entertainment before his debut, one of the fastest debuts at the company.

questions.question: Which DAY6 member handles the keyboards and synthesizers?
questions.fun_fact: His first solo album, Pilmography, debuted at No. 1 on the Gaon Album Chart in February 2022.

questions.question: Which DAY6 member is the band's leader and plays guitar?
questions.fun_fact: He released his first solo album, titled 30, on November 5, 2024, and held his first solo concert days later.

questions.question: Which song led The Book of Us: Gluon, the August 2020 debut EP of the unit Even of Day?
questions.fun_fact: JYP founder Park Jin-young named the unit: even is an old word for night, so the name promises a bright day after a dark night.

questions.question: Which song was the lead single of Fourever, the EP DAY6 released on March 18, 2024?
questions.fun_fact: Happy, a track from the same EP that was never a single, reached No. 1 on the Circle Digital Chart in September 2024.

questions.question: Which DAY6 lead single from 2019 ranked No. 10 on the Circle Digital Chart for the first half of 2024?
questions.fun_fact: The revival rolled on into Band Aid in September 2024, an EP whose title pairs band with aid, a promise to offer help.

title: TXT: From Sugar Rush Ride to Deja Vu
description: TXT in 2023 and 2024: The Name Chapter: Temptation and Freefall, minisode 3: Tomorrow with Deja Vu, and the tours and stages of that run.

questions.question: Which TXT song won Push Performance of the Year at the 2023 MTV Video Music Awards?
questions.fun_fact: The song also reached No. 1 on Billboard's US World Digital Song Sales chart in 2023.

questions.question: The January 2023 EP The Name Chapter: Temptation draws its story from which classic tale?
questions.fun_fact: American rapper Coi Leray guests on its third track, Happy Fools, and the closing ballad is called Farewell, Neverland.

questions.question: Which world tour did TXT launch in Seoul in March 2023 in support of Temptation?
questions.fun_fact: The tour opened on March 25, 2023 and closed on December 3, 2023, both times in Seoul.

questions.question: In August 2023, TXT became the first Korean group to headline which Chicago festival?
questions.fun_fact: It was their second straight Lollapalooza: on July 30, 2022 they had played a set on the smaller Solana x Perry's stage.

questions.question: Which American band joined TXT on the July 2023 single Do It Like That?
questions.fun_fact: Ryan Tedder produced the track after meeting TXT while they were touring the United States.

questions.question: Which Brazilian singer recorded the September 2023 version of Back for More with TXT?
questions.fun_fact: Mixing K-pop with Brazilian funk, it debuted at No. 41 on the Billboard Brasil Hot 100.

questions.question: Besides Do It Like That and Back for More, which song was a single from The Name Chapter: Freefall?
questions.fun_fact: Released on October 13, 2023, the album moved more than 2.4 million copies in South Korea in week one and opened at No. 1 on the Circle and Oricon album charts.

questions.question: In 2024, TXT recorded LeveL as the opening theme of which anime series?
questions.fun_fact: They made the song together with Japanese composer Hiroyuki Sawano.

questions.question: Which song was the lead single of minisode 3: Tomorrow, released on April 1, 2024?
questions.fun_fact: The EP's second track is a seven-second piece whose title is written in Morse code that reads tomorrow.

questions.question: Act: Promise, TXT's 2024 tour for minisode 3, opened on May 3 at which Seoul venue?
questions.fun_fact: The Japan leg of the tour began on July 10, 2024 at the Tokyo Dome.

title: K-pop Songs of 2025
description: Ten acts, ten songs from 2025: match Jump, Dirty Work, Earthquake, Good Goodbye and more to the K-pop act that released them.

questions.question: Which group released Jump in July 2025 as the lead single of its EP Deadline?
questions.fun_fact: It became the group's third No. 1 on the Billboard Global 200, and Dave Meyers directed its music video.

questions.question: Dirty Work, out in June 2025 as the title track of a first single album, is by which group?
questions.fun_fact: Apple co-produced its performance video, shot from start to finish on an iPhone 16 Pro, and the song went on to win four music show trophies.

questions.question: Who released Earthquake on February 14, 2025 as the lead single of her debut EP, Amortage?
questions.fun_fact: It became her first No. 1 on Billboard's World Digital Song Sales chart and her first single under her own label, Blissoo.

questions.question: Whose May 2025 EP Echo was led by the single Don't Say You Love Me?
questions.fun_fact: Its music video was shot in Singapore with actress Shin Se-kyung, the first time Jin worked with an actor.

questions.question: Which BTS member released Mona Lisa in March 2025 after previewing it at Brooklyn's Barclays Center?
questions.fun_fact: Blake Slatkin, Cashmere Cat and Misogi share the production credit, and J-Hope told his Brooklyn crowd the song was his way of showing love to ARMY.

questions.question: Good Thing, the May 2025 lead single of the EP We Are, comes from which group?
questions.fun_fact: Soyeon wrote it and co-composed it with Pop Time, Daily and Likey, drawing on early 2000s autotune styles.

questions.question: Which group released the EP Girls Will Be Girls, led by its title song, in June 2025?
questions.fun_fact: It was the group's tenth EP, a five-track release put out by JYP Entertainment and Republic Records.

questions.question: Fly Up was the lead single of Odyssey, the first studio album of which boy group, in May 2025?
questions.fun_fact: The song draws on 1950s rock and roll and won four first-place trophies on Korean music shows.

questions.question: Who released Good Goodbye in October 2025, a song that took off after her Blue Dragon Film Awards stage?
questions.fun_fact: By January 2026 it had the second-most perfect all-kills of any song and the most by a soloist.

questions.question: This Is For, the July 2025 lead single of a fourth Korean studio album, is by which group?
questions.fun_fact: Jihyo said the members pushed hard for this song to be the lead single, and in the end it was the one chosen.

title: KPop Demon Hunters Quiz
description: An easy quiz on the 2025 Netflix film KPop Demon Hunters: its directors, HUNTR/X and the Saja Boys, the voice cast and Golden's records.

questions.question: Which studio produced KPop Demon Hunters for Netflix?
questions.fun_fact: The animation itself was done by Sony Pictures Imageworks at its Vancouver and Montreal studios.

questions.question: Maggie Kang co-directed KPop Demon Hunters with which filmmaker?
questions.fun_fact: Kang first pitched the idea in 2018, and Appelhans joined after hearing it despite planning a long break after Wish Dragon.

questions.question: Who gives Rumi her speaking voice in KPop Demon Hunters?
questions.fun_fact: She first auditioned for the role of Celine and then tried out for Rumi at the urging of director Maggie Kang.

questions.question: Who provides Rumi's singing voice in the film?
questions.fun_fact: She joined the production as a songwriter, and she says the directors offered her the role after hearing her voice on the demos.

questions.question: Rei Ami is the singing voice of which character in KPop Demon Hunters?
questions.fun_fact: Audrey Nuna sings for Mira, while Zoey's speaking voice comes from Ji-young Yoo.

questions.question: Which of these songs from the film is performed by the Saja Boys?
questions.fun_fact: In the story, the demon boy band sings it at Namsan Tower to summon their master, Gwi-Ma.

questions.question: Members of which real girl group recorded the end credits version of Takedown?
questions.fun_fact: Jeongyeon, Jihyo and Chaeyoung sang it, and their version came out on June 20, 2025 as the soundtrack's lead single.

questions.question: When Golden topped the Billboard Hot 100 in August 2025, which first did it claim?
options: First K-pop song ever to top the chart
First K-pop No. 1 led by female vocalists
First No. 1 by a fictional act
First No. 1 from an animated film
questions.fun_fact: HUNTR/X also became the first all-women trio or bigger to top the chart since Destiny's Child with Bootylicious in 2001.

questions.question: In August 2025, Golden became the second K-pop No. 1 on the UK singles chart. Which song was the first?
questions.fun_fact: That same week, the Saja Boys songs Your Idol and Soda Pop climbed to No. 10 and No. 11.

questions.question: In September 2025, KPop Demon Hunters passed which show to become Netflix's most-watched title?
questions.fun_fact: Eight days earlier, on August 26, it had overtaken Red Notice to become Netflix's most-watched film.

title: BOYNEXTDOOR: From WHO! to No Genre
description: An easy quiz on BOYNEXTDOOR: KOZ Entertainment, the WHO! debut, the First Love trilogy, 19.99, No Genre and their first wins.

questions.question: Which HYBE label formed BOYNEXTDOOR in 2023?
questions.fun_fact: Rapper and producer Zico of Block B founded the label, which HYBE acquired in 2020.

questions.question: With which single album did BOYNEXTDOOR debut on May 30, 2023?
questions.fun_fact: All three of its tracks, But I Like You, One and Only and Serenade, were released as singles.

questions.question: Which WHO! song, produced by Zico, has the members open a real door on stage?
questions.fun_fact: The six members helped create its choreography, and the door gag literally acts out the group's name.

questions.question: Which song led WHY.., BOYNEXTDOOR's first EP, in 2023?
questions.fun_fact: The EP entered the Billboard 200 at No. 162, the group's first appearance on that chart.

questions.question: Which song led HOW?, the April 2024 EP that closed BOYNEXTDOOR's First Love trilogy?
questions.fun_fact: HOW? debuted at No. 1 on the Circle Album Chart, the group's first chart-topping album.

questions.question: On which music show did BOYNEXTDOOR earn their first win, on April 23, 2024?
questions.fun_fact: That June they held their first fan meeting, OneDoorful Day, at the Olympic Hall in Seoul.

questions.question: What does the title of BOYNEXTDOOR's September 2024 EP 19.99 point to?
options: The price of the album in dollars
The days they spent as trainees
questions.fun_fact: Its main single was Nice Guy, and the EP passed one million copies in cumulative sales in October 2024.

questions.question: Which song was the main single of No Genre, BOYNEXTDOOR's May 2025 EP?
questions.fun_fact: No Genre sold 1,166,419 copies in its first five days, the group's best opening week at the time.

questions.question: Which special award did BOYNEXTDOOR win at the 2023 Melon Music Awards?
questions.fun_fact: That November they also released Fadeaway as the theme song of the Naver webtoon Garbage Time.

questions.question: Which of these idols is a member of BOYNEXTDOOR?
questions.fun_fact: Taesan, Jaehyun and Woonhak take an active part in producing the group's music.
